supports: On this fixed WMT pair, P2 is the clearest public read because it best distinguishes calm selective sharpening from broad overclaiming.
Holding the tagged packet fixed shows that protocol framing alone changes how strongly customer-interface, cyber, and tariff persistence lead the read.
A matrix-first public case can be worthwhile even when the strongest result is selective rather than dramatic.
The public value here is visible judgment about boundedness, not a forced novelty claim.
does_not_yet_support: This is not a benchmark-grade claim about all retail filings, all frontier models, or all prompt families.
It does not prove that every AI or tariff refresh implies a new top-level risk thesis.
It does not justify shipping the manual-review-only outline-compare artifacts for WMT in this pass.
why_02_is_hero: P2 stays first because it best keeps the case calm while making the customer-interface, cyber, and tariff sharpenings explicit.
why_03_is_main_comparator: P1 uses the same tagged packet as P2, so the main variable is answer shape rather than evidence source.
why_00_is_control: P0 keeps the same tagged packet but shows what a simpler prompt does to specificity, prioritization, and stop discipline.
why_01_is_secondary: No separate 01 lane is shipped in this pass; the public matrix intentionally stops at P2, P1, and P0.
